architecture.decision: Keep exact owner/session/CAS and verified merged receipt. When the allocation head is an accepted ancestor rather than publication head, require both ref and canonical checkout/registration absent before terminal-only cancellation/release. Fail closed on Git/filesystem errors. Preserve immutable journal and no new owner grant. Bump producer metadata to0.20.135 in the same material change.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert; preserve all lease journals, original allocation projections and immutable tags.

nonGoals: No deletion, takeover, source restoration or new writer grant
No consumer managed-file edits or release tag retargeting
delivery.outcome: Release only the explicit current owner after its verified merged checkout and branch are already absent; publish the material recovery with patch0.20.135, including the previously approved history repair.

commands: Actual-Git missing merged branch/checkout regression; prove failure before repair and release after repair
Negative owner/CAS/receipt/ancestry/registration/symlink/Git-error regressions; existing interrupted-write controller tests
Full Goal pytest and exact-head governance
Protected CI and independent Validator merge

summary: Release verified current owner after published checkout removal
